Date 17. 12. 29.

December 17, 9

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of
your letter No. 3683 dated December 6, 1929, regarding
the whereabouts of Lu Wei Chuang ( ) and his
wife Chen Shu Ju ( ), who are reported to be
connected with the Mao Tsung Trading Co., Kobe, Japan,
and to inform you that exhaustive enquiries have been
made, but no trace can be found of these people in
Shanghai. Efforts to locate them are being continued,
and any fresh information obtained will be communicated
to you in due course.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your Obedient Servant,
Ka
s/ Director of Criminal Investigation.

Consul-General for the Netherlands,
Shanghai.

Sir,
（批：With Chinese Sect. 8/12） With reference to my letter of 27 November 1929,
No.3598, concerning Lu Wei Chuang (呂渭川) and his
wife Chen Shu Ju (陳淑如), I have the honour to in-
form you that I am now in receipt of information from
the Netherlands Consulate General at Hongkong that the
District Magistrate at Amoy issued passports 880 and
881 to the Chinese woman Tan Siok Zoo (陳淑如) aged
22 years and to her so called husband Loo Boh Chong (呂慕宗),
aged 29 years.
There exists no doubt but that Tan Siok Zoo is the
same as Chen Shu ju, and that Loo Boh Chong is the same
as Lu Mao Tsung, who in my letter referred to above I
supposed to be the same as Lu Wei Chuang.
They presented their passports to the Netherlands
Consulate General at Hongkong, who refused to give them
a visa. As the Netherlands Indian Immigration authorities
have been warned against these persons, it is not likely
that they will enter Netherlands East India, and I would
be much obliged to be informed of their whereabouts in
case they return to Shanghai.
At the time they gave their address as : Hotel Tonshin
(東昇旅館) room 31.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
The Director of Criminal Investigations, J. H. Greenway
Shanghai Municipal Council, Consul General.
SHANGHAI.

1929年12月6日

先生：
（批注：转华务股 12月8日）继我1929年11月27日第3598号关于吕渭川（呂渭川）及其妻子陈淑如（陳淑如）的信件之后，谨此告知，我现在收到荷兰驻香港总领事馆的消息，称厦门地区行政长官向中国女子陈淑如（Tan Siok Zoo），22岁，及其所谓丈夫吕慕宗（Loo Boh Chong），29岁，签发了第880号和881号护照。
毫无疑问，Tan Siok Zoo 即为陈淑如，而 Loo Boh Chong 即为吕茂宗（Lu Mao Tsung），我在上述信中曾推测吕茂宗与吕渭川为同一人。
他们向荷兰驻香港总领事馆出示了护照，但被拒发签证。由于荷属东印度移民当局已收到针对这些人的警告，他们不太可能进入荷属东印度。如果他们返回上海，若能告知其下落，我将不胜感激。
当时他们提供的地址是：东升旅馆（Hotel Tonshin）31号房间。

谨致
敬礼

您的恭顺仆人，
刑事调查处处长 J. H. Greenway
上海工部局，总领事。
上海

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 791.
Date. 21. 11. 29.

SHANGHAI, 27th November 1929.

Sir,

On about the 10th instant Lu Wei Chuang (呂渭川)
and his wife Chen Shu Ju (陳淑如) applied to this
Consulate for a visa for the Netherlands East Indies.
The man said to be owner of the Mao Tsung Trading Co.,
Sannomiya-cho 3-chome No. 33, Kobe. The fact that their
passports were issued by the Commissioner for Foreign
Affairs of Kiangsu and not by the Chinese Consul General
at Kobe seemed suspicious to me, so that I asked my col-
leagues in the latter city for particulars. I am informed
now that the Mao Tsung Trading Co. was founded in Kobe
in March 1928 by a certain Lu Mao Tsung. This man embezzled
Yen 70,000.- from various banks and firms and fled to China
in July of this year. Perhaps Lu Mao Tsung and Lu Wei
Chuang are the same person.

The two applicants for visas were at the time accom-
panied by a Japanese Ro Shiki Ki (侶式期郎) or in
Chinese Lu Suh Chi Lang, who had a passport, issued by
the Governor of Hyogo Prefecture (Kobe) in the course of
this year, and said to be a nephew of Lu Wei Chuang.

It further appears that Ro Shiki Ki and Lu Mao Tsung
are brothers, natives of Formosa and Japanese subjects.

If the Police should know something about the where-
abouts of these people at Shanghai I should be glad to
be informed.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
（签名：J. H. Groenman）
Consul General.

The Director of Criminal Investigations,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
SHANGHAI.

刑事调查处档案室
编号 I. O. D. 791.
日期 1929. 11. 21.

上海，1929年11月27日

先生：

本月10日左右，吕渭川（呂渭川）及其妻子陈淑如（陳淑如）向本领事馆申请前往荷属东印度的签证。该男子自称是神户三宫町三丁目33号毛宗商行（Mao Tsung Trading Co.）的所有者。他们的护照是由江苏外交专员签发，而非由中国驻神户总领事签发，这一事实令我生疑，因此我向驻该城市的同事询问详情。现获悉，毛宗商行由一名叫吕茂宗（Lu Mao Tsung）的人于1928年3月在神户创立。此人从多家银行和公司侵吞了7万日元，并于今年7月逃往中国。也许吕茂宗和吕渭川是同一人。

两名签证申请人当时由一名日本人侣式期郎（Ro Shiki Ki）或中文名吕式期郎陪同，他持有今年由兵库县（神户）知事签发的护照，并自称是吕渭川的侄子。

此外，似乎侣式期郎和吕茂宗是兄弟，均为台湾原住民且为日本臣民。

如果警方知道这些人在上海的下落，请告知我，我将不胜感激。

谨致
敬礼

您的恭顺仆人，
（签名：J. H. Groenman）
总领事

刑事调查处处长，
上海工部局，
上海

Consul General Der Nederlander
voor Midden-China.
Tel. A.D.Hollandia.
Shanghai 27th Nov. 1929.
No. 3598. -C-O-P-Y-

Sir,

On about the 10th instant Lu Wei Chuang ( 盧偉昌 ) and his wife Chen Shu Ju ( 陳淑如 ) applied to this Consulate for a visa for the Netherlands East Indies. The man said to be owner of the Mao Tsung Trading Co., Sannemiya-Cho 3 Chome No.33, Kobe. The fact that their passports were issued by the Commissioner for Foreign Affairs of Kiangsu and not by the Chinese Consul General at Kobe seemed suspicious to me, so that I asked my colleague in the latter city for particulars. I am informed now that the Mao Tsung Trading Co. was founded in Kobe in March 1928 by a certain Lu Mao Tsung. This man embezzled Yen 70,000.-from various banks and firms and fled to China in July of this year. Perhaps Lu Mao Tsung and Lu Wei Chuang are the same person.

The two applicants for visas were at the time accompanied by a Japanese Ro Shiki Ki ( 呂式期郎 ) or in Chinese Lu Suh Chi Lang, who had a passport, issued by the Governor of Hyogo Prefecture (Kobe) in the course of this year, and said to be a nephew of Lu Wei Chuang.

It further appears that Ro Shiki Ki and Lu Mao Tsung are brothers, natives of Formosa and Japanese subjects.

If the police should know something about the whereabouts of these people at Shanghai I should be glad to be informed.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your Obedient Servant,

The Director of Criminal Investigation.
Shanghai Municipal Council.
SHANGHAI.
Consul General.

荷兰驻华中总领事
电话地址：Hollandia
上海 1929年11月27日
第3598号 -副本-

先生：

本月10日左右，卢伟昌（Lu Wei Chuang，原文此处汉字为盧偉昌）及其妻子陈淑如（Chen Shu Ju，陳淑如）向本领事馆申请前往荷属东印度的签证。该男子自称是神户三宫町三丁目33号毛宗商行的所有者。他们的护照是由江苏外交专员签发，而非由中国驻神户总领事签发，这一事实令我生疑，因此我向驻该城市的同事询问详情。现获悉，毛宗商行由一名叫吕茂宗（Lu Mao Tsung）的人于1928年3月在神户创立。此人从多家银行和公司侵吞了7万日元，并于今年7月逃往中国。也许吕茂宗和吕渭川是同一人。

两名签证申请人当时由一名日本人吕式期郎（Ro Shiki Ki，原文此处汉字为呂式期郎）或中文名吕式期郎陪同，他持有今年由兵库县（神户）知事签发的护照，并自称是吕渭川的侄子。

此外，似乎吕式期郎和吕茂宗是兄弟，均为台湾原住民且为日本臣民。

如果警方知道这些人在上海的下落，请告知我，我将不胜感激。

谨致
敬礼

您的恭顺仆人，

刑事调查处处长
上海工部局
上海
总领事
